scope: Substantive refresh of an existing post at its URL, adding sources

observations.summary: California Energy Commission regulations: toilets no more than 1.28 gallons per flush, effective January 1, 2016.
observations.inference_limit: Code body summary of the regulation; reused from the plumbing terms refresh fetched 2026-10-26.

observations.summary: Federal standard 1.6 gpf; WaterSense 1.28 or less; older toilets as much as 6 gpf; toilets nearly 30 percent of average indoor home water use.

Section 3.1 single flush max 1.28 gpf; Section 3.2 dual flush: neither mode may exceed 1.28 gpf; Section 4.1 must completely clear all test media in a single flush in at least four of five attempts; Section 1.0 toilets with user or plumber adjustable settings that override the rated volume are not eligible.
observations.inference_limit: Label specification, not a code requirement.

observations.summary: Applies to property built and available for use on or before January 1, 1994; noncompliant toilet is one manufactured to use more than 1.6 gpf; single-family owners replace by January 1, 2017; from January 1, 2014 permit applicants for alterations or improvements replace noncompliant fixtures as a condition of final approval; from January 1, 2017 sellers disclose the requirement and any noncompliant fixtures.
observations.inference_limit: Enrolled bill text; exemptions in Section 1101.7 not summarized in the post.

observations.summary: 2010 ADA Standards 604.4: water closet seat height 17 inches minimum and 19 inches maximum above the finish floor.
observations.inference_limit: Text read from the corada.com mirror of the 2010 ADA Standards because the Access Board page was truncated; applies to accessible facilities, cited in the post only as a reference height for homeowners.

observations.summary: Corrected an outdated 1.6 gallon single flush figure and an 0.8 and 1.6 gallon dual flush figure that exceed California limits; removed a 3.5 gallon older standard claim, utility bill savings claims, a fewer moving parts claim, a precision and care claim, a city list, a templated FAQ answer, off-topic tags and an inline stock image; corrected the hero alt text to the photo; added pressure assisted toilets, California Civil Code 1101.4, WaterSense testing, seat height and rough-in guidance, and links to the running toilet, flange and rebates pages. Original date kept, updated set to 2026-10-30.
